verdict.rationale: Pilot's pricing page lists 'Full accounts payable' and 'Custom workflows and reporting', and the portal offers real-time account data, so AP visibility is implied. Nothing explicitly documents an AP aging report or vendor balances at an arbitrary date. Missing for 10: explicit AP aging report, point-in-time vendor balance views, documentation of how accountants access these reports (portal or QuickBooks), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
